findings: Constant-input normalization divides by zero and produces NaN in isolated original-function control. Independent affine normalization erases scale and offset; this property alone is not a correctness bug.

Original flow smoothness subtracts the last row/column, not adjacent positions. Controlled input yields 1.6249997968750256 versus adjacent reference 1.1249998593750177. Caller reachability and training impact unverified.
Masked MSE/L1 return zero for an all-zero mask with finite inputs, regardless of image differences. A zero masked loss is not an identity certificate. Static assessment.
VGG16/19 and LPIPS losses train image synthesis; no exact duplicate classifier. VGGLoss preprocess size parameter does not resize images.
Criterion boundary crop changes prediction/target without cropping mask; L1 resizes mask while MSE does not. No full model execution.
cycle on an empty iterable loops without yielding; not executed. dict_to_device mutates shallow exact Tensor values and uses CUDA.
save_current_code copies a filtered directory snapshot without content hashes; not executed. mse2psnr epsilon caps zero-MSE output at 60 dB by formula.

executed_controls.method: Unchanged original function AST bodies; NumPy arrays and minimal torch.norm adapter. No Torch/model runtime.
